artworks.title: Bad humor, malcontentment
artworks.description: The image shows a profile portrait of a man from the shoulders up. He is positioned in a side view facing the right side of the image. The man has a medium complexion with distinct lines on his face, and his hair appears dark and combed to the side, hanging over his forehead. He is wearing a loose-fitting garment, open at the front, which reveals his chest and shoulder. An object resembling a probe or rod is extended towards his face, near his nose. The background is dark without any discernible details.

artworks.title: Gaiety expressed by the ideas of lustfulness, cynicism and lewdness
artworks.description: The image shows an upper-body profile of a person facing right, with their face turned slightly towards the viewer. The person is captured in profile with visible expressive features; deep wrinkles are notable. Their hair is short and combed back. They are wearing a light-colored garment with buttons down the front. The person holds a thin string or wire in one hand, which extends towards their face and connects to a small object held by another hand, suggesting a pair of spectacles or glasses being maneuvered. The background is plain and neutral, and the image has a soft, sepia tone.

artworks.title: A relaxed expression (left); Disgust (right)
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper body of a man. The man has a prominent brow, deep-set eyes, a straight nose, and a thin mustache, with lips positioned slightly asymmetrically. His hair is wispy, slightly long, and receding on top. He is wearing a loose, open white shirt that partially reveals his chest. Another man with a bald head and a beard is partially visible on the left side, slightly turned towards the main subject. The background is plain and blurred.

artworks.title: Pain and despair
artworks.artist: Guillaume-Benjamin-Amant Duchenne (de Boulogne), French, 1806 - 1875, and Adrien Tournachon, French, 1825 - 1903
artworks.creditLine: W. Bruce and Delaney H. Lundberg Fund, in Honor of the 25th Anniversary of Photography at the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated facing the camera. An apparatus holds his mouth open. His facial features include a pronounced brow, deep lines across his forehead, and a visible frown emphasized by the device. His hair is thinning and combed back, revealing more of his scalp. He wears a loosely fitted shirt with an open collar. Two other individuals are partially visible, wearing suits suggestive of a formal setting. One on either side of the man holds the device in place. The background is plain and slightly blurred with no noticeable details or objects.

artworks.title: Weeping, tears of pity (left); Relaxed face (right)
artworks.artist: Guillaume-Benjamin-Amant Duchenne (de Boulogne) and Adrien Tournachon
artworks.description: The image features two men from the waist up. The man on the left has a receding hairline, unkempt hair on the sides, defined facial features, and is wearing a disheveled open-necked shirt. The man on the right has short hair, sideburns, and is dressed in a dark jacket and white shirt. The background is a uniform sepia tone.

artworks.title: Discontent, bad humor
artworks.description: The image shows an upper body portrait of a middle-aged man seated, captured from the chest upward. The man has a wrinkled face with pronounced lines and slightly sunken cheeks. His expression is tense, and his mouth is open. He has thin hair on top and longer strands at the sides. He wears a loose, light-colored, long-sleeved garment revealing part of his chest. Two hands, likely belonging to another person not fully visible, are extending from the right-hand side of the frame. These hands are manipulating wires attached to the man's face around his nose and mouth. The background is blurry and nondescript, with a neutral-toned surface focusing on the man and the hands interacting with him.

artworks.title: Surprise
artworks.creditLine: W. Bruce and Delaney H. Lundberg Fund, in Honor of the 25th Anniversary of Photography at the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper body of two men. One man is behind the other, who appears to be a mannequin. The man in the foreground has fabric draped over his shoulders, resembling a shirt, with an expressionless face, open mouth, thin lips, visible cheekbones, thin combed-back hair, and some strands falling forward. The man on the left is adjusting wires near the mannequin's face. He wears a dark garment with a white collar and a cap. The background is plain and out of focus, focusing on the individuals in the foreground.

artworks.title: Astonishment, stupefaction, amazement
artworks.creditLine: W. Bruce and Delaney H. Lundberg Fund, in Honor of the 25th Anniversary of Photography at the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows the upper body of a man seated in profile, turned to his right, with his face tilted slightly upward and his mouth open. His facial features include a prominent nose, visible wrinkles on his forehead, and he has medium-length hair that appears slightly unkempt. The man's shirt is partially open, exposing his collarbone area. A hand is applying a device to the top of the man's head. The background is dark.

artworks.title: This contraction of m. platysma alone lacks expression
artworks.creditLine: W. Bruce and Delaney H. Lundberg Fund, in Honor of the 25th Anniversary of Photography at the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals from the waist up, positioned closely to one another. The person on the left is standing or sitting with his shoulders straight, revealing his bare chest as his shirt is unbuttoned and open. His facial features are prominent with a furrowed brow and slightly parted lips. His hair is thinning and combed back, and he is wearing an open white shirt. The person on the right is leaning towards the other man's shoulder. His bald head is turned to the left, and he is wearing a dark suit while holding a probe-like tool against the other person's chest. The background is a plain, slightly textured wall with no distinct features.

artworks.title: Expression of terror
artworks.description: This photograph shows a realistic mannequin head with a bald top and some hair on the sides, displaying a surprised or pained expression. There are metal rods or wires connected to its face and neck. A person in the background, wearing a dark vest over a light shirt, is adjusting or manipulating the fixture on the mannequin. The lighting and focus create a dramatic atmosphere.

artworks.title: Terror mixed with pain, torture
artworks.creditLine: W. Bruce and Delaney H. Lundberg Fund, in Honor of the 25th Anniversary of Photography at the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: Two men apply rod-like devices to a third man, whose chin is pulled back, mouth wide open, and eyebrows angled sharply upward in this vertical black and white photograph. Printed in tones of golden brown and black, the bare chest of the central man and his white shirt stand out against the shadowy background. To our left, one man wears a black vest over a white shirt with the sleeves rolled up to the elbows. He holds rods to either side of the central man’s neck. To our right, another man wears a dark suit, white tie, and spectacles perched at the end of his nose. He holds two rods to the central man’s eyebrows. All three men appear to have pale skin and dark hair with prominent mutton chops.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman in a half-body portrait in a dignified and composed position. She has defined and symmetrical facial features with a calm expression. Her hair is styled in a center-parted updo with rolled sides. She is wearing a dark, long-sleeved gown with a fitted bodice and a large white lace collar. She has a floral brooch at the center of the collar. She is holding her hands in her lap, showing rings on her fingers. The background is neutral and slightly out of focus, keeping the focus on the woman. The image is framed in an ornate frame with decorative gold and a spotted pattern along the edges, typical of historical photographic styles.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman sitting on a red sofa. She has a straight face and is holding a fan on her lap. She has brown hair styled in an updo and wears a blue dress with white lace details. The background has brown tones and red drapery.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Mother and Child
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman holding an infant in her lap. The woman has dark, center-parted hair styled in waves and is adorned with large bows. She has dark eyes and a slightly curved mouth. The woman wears a striped dress with lace details. The infant has light hair and wears a dotted gown. They are framed by decorative floral patterns. The background is plain and neutral.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Mother, Child, and Two Women
artworks.description: The image shows three women and a baby, all seated and visible from the waist up. The woman on the left holds an infant on her lap. The women are positioned in a row, with the left woman having dark hair, styled in curls, and wearing a striped dress with a lace collar. The middle woman also has curled dark hair, is wearing a dark dress with a white collar, and has her hands in her lap. The woman on the right has dark hair, styled with a middle part and curls at the sides, wearing a dark dress with a high lace collar and patterned sleeves. The women wear brooches and possibly earrings. The background is plain, with an ornate decorative frame around the image.

artworks.title: Rapids and Cascades, Franconia Notch, New Hampshire
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a natural scene of a rocky landscape with trees and a waterfall visible on the right side. The rocks and trees dominate the view, with some rocks covered by foliage and others wet from the flowing water. The trees frame the waterfall and contrast against the rocks. The color palette consists of sepia tones, enhancing the natural textures with a monochromatic theme.

artworks.title: Parade Marshal, Dayton, Ohio
artworks.description: The image shows a person riding a horse in the foreground. The individual is sitting upright on the horse, holding the reins with one hand. The person appears to be wearing a top hat, a long coat, and a dark hat. In the background, there is a crowd of people standing on the sidewalk in front of a building with windows and signage. The street is unpaved, with storefronts and bystanders in the area.

artworks.title: House on a Hillside
artworks.description: The image shows a white house in a rural landscape, framed by an ornate oval frame. A tree partially obscures the house, with branches spreading out. The horizon is mostly hidden by a sloping hillside. The image is monochromatic and resembles a daguerreotype, giving it a vintage, sepia-toned look. A dirt road curves towards the house, lined with a wooden fence. Hills rise in the background, completing the rural scene.

artworks.title: Hingham, Massachusetts
artworks.description: The image depicts a dirt road with a house nearby. In the distance, there are two houses with pitched roofs, chimneys, and trees. The photo is in monochrome, with smooth surfaces, clear lines, and gentle shading. The color palette consists of black, white, and various shades of gray, with a hint of blue and sepia. Three figures are standing in front of a wooden fence.

artworks.title: Portrait of Two Girls
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dennis A. Waters, New Hampshire
artworks.description: The image shows an upper-body portrait of two young women. One is seated while the other is standing closely behind her, resting her arm on her shoulder. Both women have smooth, youthful faces and wear their hair styled with a middle part and pulled back. The seated woman has more defined facial features and wears a dark, long-sleeved dress with a white collar and cuffs. The standing woman also wears a dark dress with a fitted bodice. The image is set in a decorative frame, typical of daguerreotypes. The background behind the women is plain and muted.

artworks.title: Shipping on the Oresund with Helsingor and Kronborg Castle in the Distance
artworks.medium: graphite with stumping and scratching out on tinted scraping paper (papier Pellee, a thick paper, covered with a white ground, and topped with a uniform light gray tint)
artworks.description: The image shows a shoreline, a calm body of water, a cityscape, and a harbor. The horizon is low, with a sky filled with scattered clouds. A large ship with full sails is on the right, with smaller boats rowing towards the city. The city has various buildings, spires, windmills, and smoking structures. A tree-lined area is on the left. The color palette is monochromatic, with grayscale tones creating depth. The brushstrokes suggest delicate rendering with emphasis on architectural and textural details.

artworks.title: A Temple Ruin in Agrigento
artworks.medium: watercolor with gouache on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a view from below of ancient ruins, with three tall columns supporting a partial structure. The horizon is visible with trees and bushes meeting the sky. The sun casts shadows on the columns and steps. A figure in traditional attire sits on the steps. The brushstrokes are detailed, depicting the stone and foliage textures. The color palette is warm with browns and greens, contrasting with a soft blue sky. The scene conveys a serene atmosphere with a harmonious balance between natural and man-made elements.

artworks.title: The Colosseum Seen from the Palatine Hill
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache over traces of graphite, touched with gum arabic, on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with ancient ruins and lush vegetation. A person in dark clothing is seated on a slope covered with green and yellow brush. Crumbling brick arches are visible among the foliage. Trees and shrubbery fill the middle distance, leading to the distant view of the Colosseum against rolling hills and mountains. The sky is a bright blue with fluffy clouds. The color palette includes earthy browns, lush greens, and warm beige tones. The painting features fine, textured brushstrokes creating a detailed yet soft representation of the scene.

artworks.title: The Bride of Lammermoor
artworks.medium: pen and black ink, wash, and graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of J. William Middendorf, II, 1977)
artworks.description: Two figures are depicted outside a building. On the left, a man is standing with one leg crossed over the other, pointing a finger toward the woman on the right. He has shoulder-length curly hair, a hat with a feather or ribbon, and is dressed in 18th-century attire. The woman on the right appears to be stepping or dancing, with one arm raised above her head and the other extended forward. She has wavy hair and is wearing a flowing dress. The background includes a building with open windows, a door, wooden fencing, a tree, and shrubbery. The scene is monochromatic, presented on aged, sepia-toned paper with signs of wear.
